submitted.body:
Owner settled the PI-3 delivery decisions. **No legacy:** v0.3 opens only a fresh v0.3 store; a v0.1 or v0.2 store is refused. **Supported pair:** client 0.3 with server 0.3, both copied into versions/0.3 FoundationOS. **Sessions:** the HttpOnly cookie carries the server token, bound to the installation; the host only proxies. **Control:** server console with O/R/Q, and a one-time client pairing. **Profile:** SQLite is authoritative and profile.json is deleted. **Retention:** reserve the username and Home for 30 days, then hard delete. **Credentials:** 6-character minimum, scrypt, the 5/1/3/5/15-minute rate ladder, six-digit invite and member-reset codes, 16-character owner recovery code. **Delivery:** two PRs, PR 1 after Sprint 3, no waiting between them, Edge never merges.

The full table, the adopted defaults and the record edits that follow are in [PI-3 owner decisions](PI-03/owner-decisions.md). WI-060 is repurposed to refuse older stores; WI-056 becomes store creation rather than migration; the PI acceptance loses the upgrade promise; a preferences-sync item is added.
